_doc: Walk Studio COST-PLUS PRICING — single source of truth for per-video pricing.
All money is in integer CENTS (USD), matching producer.py's convention (1 Higgsfield
credit ~= 1 cent; Seedance ~22-27cr/clip, gpt_image_2 ~7cr, edge-tts/Remotion/walk-agent free).
NO TIERS. The price is the agent's REAL production COGS (its scene plan) x a MARKUP, with a
price FLOOR, rounded to a clean increment:
Consumed ONLY when env WS_PREMIUM_MENU=1. pricing.py is the loader/API; do not hand-edit
consumers against this file directly. plan_cogs_cents = the variable-spend ceiling the budget
gate locks; price_cents = what the customer pays. margin = (price - cogs) / price.
ONE customer choice, made UPFRONT: a QUALITY dimension (standard | premium). It is NOT a
flat add-on — it changes WHAT THE AGENT PRODUCES, and therefore the plan COGS that drives
- standard: Remotion designed motion-graphics + edge-tts voiceover. NO Higgsfield, NO
ElevenLabs. COGS is ~free, so the price lands at the floor (~$5).
- premium: adds cinematic AI footage (Higgsfield) + a natural ElevenLabs voiceover. Those
land in COGS, so the cost-plus price rises (~$6-9). The `cogs_floor_cents` below is a
small minimum premium COGS so premium always reads as a richer tier even on a thin plan.

standard.label: Standard
standard._doc: Remotion designed motion-graphics + edge-tts voiceover. No Higgsfield, no ElevenLabs — COGS ~free, price floors at $5.
standard.blurb: Designed motion graphics + a clean synthetic voice. Fast and free to make.

premium.label: Premium
premium._doc: Cinematic AI footage (Higgsfield) + a natural ElevenLabs voiceover. Those land in COGS so the cost-plus price rises to ~$6-9. cogs_floor_cents (100c=$1) guarantees premium reads as the richer tier ($6+) even on a thin/mock plan; a real multi-clip Higgsfield plan exceeds it naturally.
premium.blurb: Cinematic AI footage (Higgsfield) + a natural studio voice (ElevenLabs). Richer and more lifelike.
